description: This donut chart, titled “Task Type,” visually represents the distribution of tasks performed by Agency B, as detailed in the paper “Developing Story Case Studies of Generative AI's Use in Journalism.” The chart is divided into three distinct segments, each labeled with its corresponding task type and percentage. The largest segment, colored a deep red, represents “Article generation” and accounts for 82.9% of the total. The second segment, a light blue, corresponds to “Article editing” and makes up 14.6%. The smallest segment, a pale yellow, indicates “Headline generation” and constitutes 2.4%. Each category is explicitly labeled with its name and percentage value positioned outside the ring, and there is no legend or internal percentage labels within the slices. The segments are arranged in descending order of size, starting from the largest at the top left and proceeding clockwise.
